data.one_liner: YAML manipulation library preserving comments and whitespace
data.what_it_does: Provides a YamlEditor class to parse, modify, and serialize YAML while keeping comments and formatting intact. It supports updates, inserts, deletions, and conversion from JSON.
use_when: You need to edit YAML files programmatically while keeping comments
You want to convert JSON to YAML with preserved structure
You require fine-grained control over YAML nodes
avoid_when: You only need simple YAML parsing without comment preservation
You need a code generation tool for YAML schemas
strengths: Supports complex updates via path-based API
weaknesses: Map keys always added in flow style

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard YAML parsing without comment preservation
